description: Retrieve daily COVID-19 hospitalization data from HHS Protect via CMU Delphi for US states. Returns adult and pediatric ICU/hospital patient counts, new daily admissions, and bed utilization metrics per state per day. Data available from 2020-07-15 onward. Supports multi-state queries and date ranges in YYYYMMDD format. Useful for tracking pandemic hospital burden over time. No auth — HHS/CMU Delphi open public health data, unlimited free.

dates.description: Date(s) in YYYYMMDD format. Single: "20210101". Range: "20210101-20210131". Daily HHS hospitalization data, available from 2020-07-15 onward.

states.description: 2-letter US state abbreviation(s) (e.g. "ca", "ny", "tx"). Comma-separated for multiple states: "ca,ny,tx".

name: delphi.covid.hospitalization

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: CMU Delphi — COVID-19 Hospitalization State Timeseries
